• PANTRY STAPLE: Our most versatile flour for any recipe that simply calls for flour; Brings out the best in your baked goods

  • BAKING ESSENTIAL: Strong enough for high rising yeast breads, mellow enough for pizza dough, cookies, cakes, and flaky pie crusts

  • CRUST TO CRUMB: Consistent, all purpose flour that bakers can count on

  • ENDLESS USES: Keep a bag of this premium quality flour on hand for your last minute baking needs; Get inspired by recipes on our website

  • CONTAINS: One 2 lb bag of Gold Medal All Purpose Flour
features:
Features

All-purpose versatility: Made from a balanced blend of hard and soft wheat, perfect for a wide variety of baking recipes.

Presifted and bleached: Delivers a whiter appearance and finer texture, and it’s ready to use right out of the bag—no need to sift Features

All-purpose versatility: Made from a balanced blend of hard and soft wheat, perfect for a wide variety of baking recipes.

Presifted and bleached: Delivers a whiter appearance and finer texture, and it’s ready to use right out of the bag—no need to sift.

Enriched flour: Contains added nutrients like iron and B-vitamins including niacin, thiamin, riboflavin, and folic acid.

Kosher certified: Suitable for kosher diets and meets high-quality production standards.

No trans fat or cholesterol: A cleaner choice for health-conscious bakers.

Trusted brand: Produced by Gold Medal, a heritage brand known for over 135 years of baking excellence.

Benefits

Truly all-purpose: Ideal for baking cookies, cakes, muffins, pie crusts, pancakes, waffles, and even pizza dough.

Consistent results: Helps ensure even rising, soft texture, and great flavor in a wide range of baked goods.

Convenient to use: The flour is already sifted and bleached, making prep quicker and easier.

Supports nutrition: Enriched with essential nutrients that may support overall health when used in daily recipe

Lighter baking: With no trans fats or cholesterol, it aligns better with modern, balanced diets.

Reliable and trusted: Home bakers and professionals alike trust Gold Medal for dependable baking results every time.
ingredients: Bleached Wheat Flour, Niacin (a B vitamin), Iron, Thiamine Mononitrate (vitamin B1), Riboflavin (vitamin B2), Enzymes, Folic Acid (a B Vitamin).
